products.name: CoCounsel (Casetext)
products.note: Legal research AI; litigation support; Westlaw integration; attorney work product risk

profile_text.body:
Thomson Reuters is a publicly traded global content and technology company (Nasdaq/TSX: TRI, CIK 0001075124) that describes itself as delivering purpose-built technology to professionals in the legal, tax, accounting, risk, fraud, and government sectors. Its stated aim is to help professionals make faster decisions and gain sharper insights, with its offerings spanning research, analysis, drafting, trade compliance, and connected tax and legal workflows through a platform it calls ONESOURCE+.

The company's primary AI product is CoCounsel, which it describes as built on the principles of what it calls Fiduciary-Grade AI and integrated with its Westlaw and Practical Law content. CoCounsel is positioned for legal research, litigation support, and multi-step professional workflows. The site cites a case study in which a firm called Justly Prudent used CoCounsel and Westlaw AI and reported increasing litigation capacity by 100%. Thomson Reuters also offers AI-powered Harmonized System code classification for import and export trade compliance, and notes it is launching what it calls its first production-grade agentic workflows on CoCounsel. The company released its 2026 Future of Professionals Report and its 2026 AI in Professional Services Report, the latter drawing on perspectives from more than 1,500 professionals, both addressing how generative AI and agentic AI are reshaping professional services.
